title: Core: AS2 switch/case statement compilation
description: Verify AS2 switch/case compiles correctly to AVM1 bytecode. switch(x) { case 1: break; case 2: break; default: } should compile using ActionStrictEquals (0xAC) comparisons and branch jumps. Test fall-through (no break), string cases, and nested switch. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/switchcase.test.ts.
